shortDescription: Status line with usage limits, Fable usage, system health, and terminal fitting.
longDescription: A configurable Claude Code status line: context, disk and /tmp headroom, 5-hour and 7-day limits, weekly Fable usage from the usage endpoint, bars that shrink and an exclusion ladder that fit any terminal width, an optional resize watcher, and drift controls, with matching bash and PowerShell renderers.
defaultPrompt: Make my Fable bar 14 cells long and preview it.
Hide the /tmp segment from my status line.
Make the status line fit my split pane.
Why is my Fable usage showing n/a?
